Name: Chubby Sam
Author: Pixel3r
Description:
I got a request for this mod a long while back, shortly after my Really Heavy Sebby mod went up.
This mod makes Sam quite pudgy, though his active lifestyle means he isn't as big as Sebastian, he's bigger than your average young man.

An excellent companion to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/534/?]Really Heavy Sebby [/url]and your choice of Plus Sized Abigail mod (there's more than enough of them...)
